payload.goal: Register supplier invoice from Fossekraft AS in Tripletex, creating the supplier first if missing, with expense account 6340 and input VAT 25%.
success_checks: Supplier Fossekraft AS with org.nr 858573483 exists in Tripletex.
Supplier invoice INV-2026-2464 is registered with invoice date 2026-05-07 and due date 2026-06-06.
Invoice is posted to expense account 6340.
Input VAT is registered at 25% with VAT amount 13837.
Gross amount equals 69187 and net amount equals 55350.
Supplier bank account 76767487637 is stored if supported.
risk_notes: Customer/company receiving the invoice is only stated as 'Ditt firma'; exact company context may need confirmation in a real environment.
Currency is implied NOK but not explicitly stated.
Supplier invoice series/internal voucher settings may be required by Tripletex.
Exact supplier invoice payload fields can vary; attachment import may require separate upload/linking.
If account 6340 or VAT code mapping differs in the target accounting setup, posting may need adjustment.
ordered_steps: Check whether supplier with organization number 858573483 exists via supplier lookup endpoint.
If missing, create supplier Fossekraft AS with org.nr 858573483, address Sjøgata 127, 3015 Drammen, and bank account 76767487637.
Resolve correct input VAT code for 25% incoming VAT in the accounting setup.
Create/register supplier invoice for supplier Fossekraft AS with invoice number INV-2026-2464, invoice date 2026-05-07, due date 2026-06-06, and bank account 76767487637.
Add invoice line or posting line: description 'Skylagring', account 6340, net amount 55350, VAT 25%.
Verify calculated VAT amount is 13837 and total payable is 69187.
Attach or reference the PDF if attachment upload is supported.
Confirm the supplier invoice is saved/booked successfully and retrievable by invoice number INV-2026-2464.

planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
Use ?number=XXXX to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
Do NOT use other query params — they are not supported.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.

When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting. If this fails with a balance error, fall back to manual postings for all legs.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

payload.headline: Supplier and voucher created but 2 checks failed, likely due to wrong VAT type or posting structure
what_went_wrong: Check 4 failed: vatType id=0 used for expense line (6340) instead of proper no-VAT type or the VAT should be embedded in the expense posting, not split manually.
Check 6 failed: The accounts payable posting (2400) may be missing the supplier reference or due date, causing the invoice linkage check to fail.
First voucher attempt (single-leg) failed with 422 'sum not zero', wasting one API call and requiring a retry with manual 3-leg postings.
Extra GET /ledger/account calls for 2711 (medium rate) were made before correcting to 2710 (high rate 25%), adding unnecessary calls.
what_worked: Supplier Fossekraft AS created successfully on first attempt with correct org number and address.
Final 3-leg voucher was accepted by Tripletex and created with correct amounts (55350/13837/69187).
what_to_try_next: Add supplier reference and due date (2026-06-06) to the accounts payable (2400) posting to ensure invoice linkage checks pass.
Use the correct vatType on the expense line (6340) — either the proper 25% input VAT type (id=14) or no-VAT (null/omit), not id=0, to pass VAT-related checks.
Skip the intermediate 2711 account lookup and go directly to 2710 for 25% standard rate, reducing API calls from 9 to 7.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/account for account 2711 (medium rate) — not needed since 25% VAT uses 2710 (high rate).
POST /ledger/voucher (first attempt) with single-leg posting — predictably fails since voucher postings must sum to zero.
